overview_description.description:
Glowing.io enables hotels and their guests to message each other in whatever mobile messaging app each guest prefers.

Their solutions offer real-time, in-the-moment communication with every single person at the hotel. It’s easy for guests – no apps to download – AND simple for hotel staff – no software to install.

product.name: Glowing Customer Engagement Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based omni-channel messaging platform enabling businesses to communicate with customers across multiple messaging apps and languages.

product.name: Custom Integration Services
product.description: API-driven integration services that connect Glowing’s platform with existing business systems to automate workflows and synchronize data.

product.name: 365-Day Customer and Technical Support
product.description: Year-round customer service and technical support available via multiple communication channels including email, phone, texting, ticket submission, and webchat.

product.name: Training Programs
product.description: Short video training courses designed to help users and administrators learn to operate and configure the Glowing platform.
